# Account-based ads (LinkedIn Matched Audiences and display)

Spend needs gate G4. Audience: the account list (company match) plus committee job functions. Frequency cap: 3 a week per person.

| Format | Tier | Headline (max 70 characters) | Intro text (max 150 characters) | CTA |
|--------|------|-------------------------------|----------------------------------|-----|
| Single image, warm-up (P1) | 1, 2, 3 | "{{problem}} in {{industry}}: what changed in {{year}}" | "{{insight}}. A short guide for {{role_plural}}." | Download |
| Single image, cluster (P3) | 2 | "For {{cluster_name}}: {{value_point}}" | "How {{approved_reference}} {{approved_result}}." | Learn more |
| Conversation ad | 1 | "{{first_name}}, a question about {{topic}}" | 2 choices: "Send me the guide" / "Book 20 minutes" | — |
| Document ad | 2, 3 | "{{report_title}}" | "{{3_key_findings}}" | Download |
| Display (account IP match) | 3 | "{{company_name}} + {{client}}" (only if approved) | — | See how |

Rules: no claims without claim_id; EU ads follow the Digital Services Act ad transparency rules; GCC ads in Arabic for government-linked accounts; never say "we saw you researching".
